verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public GitHub repository (runanywhere-gh-1), and a community comment says the RCLI repo is MIT-licensed (runanywhere-comm-10). Nothing documents a contribution process: no contributing guide, pull-request or review workflow, or path to collaborator recognition. A public repo and an open-source license are adjacent signals, not the capability the story asks for, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can contribute code and become a recognized collaborator through the project's open-source process
